Description

An electronic management system supervises and governs all engine parameters. It optimises performance and fuel consumption by responding in real time to different service conditions.

The system is managed by a single control unit which controls both the ignition and the injection.

The system uses signals received from numerous sensors to control actuators. It is connected to the following systems:

  • fuel supply;
  • air supply system;
  • engine cooling;
  • control of combustion - Lambda sensors
  • control of exhaust with catalytic silencer.
  • fuel vapour recirculation.

Thanks to the electronic management described above, this engine conforms to the latest anti-pollution and continuous control regulations in accordance with the EOBD (European On Board Diagnosis) system; this system permits continuous diagnosis of the vehicle components relating to emissions, and indicates to the user, by switching on the relevant warning light on the instrument panel, any deterioration in these components.

For greater detail, see 1056 .

The system is also controlled by means of special relays located in the engine compartment unit; the supply lines to the control unit and the various system components (sensors and actuators) are protected by special fuses, also located in the engine compartment.
